cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(forge_cmake_runtime LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
add_library(cmake_private SHARED private.cc)
add_library(cmake_plugin SHARED plugin.cc)
target_link_libraries(cmake_plugin PRIVATE cmake_private)
add_executable(cmake_app main.cc)
target_link_libraries(cmake_app PRIVATE dl)
install(TARGETS cmake_app cmake_plugin cmake_private RUNTIME DESTINATION bin LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES plugin_api.h DESTINATION include)
install(FILES marker.txt DESTINATION share/cmake)
